featured_reviews.name: Vipul J Meher
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at this shop was very disappointing. I bought a pair of JoyBean brand sandals for ₹1,500. The shopkeeper initially quoted ₹1,900, and after bargaining, I purchased them for ₹1,500. However, when I returned home and checked the brand’s official website, I found that the MRP was ₹1,399 and the selling price was ₹1,245. Moreover, the original price tag had been removed from the item.

It appears that inflating the price first and then reducing it during bargaining is a tactic used to make customers feel satisfied, while still giving the shopkeeper an unfair advantage.

This practice is misleading and unfair. I advise others to avoid such fraudulent shops. If you do visit, make sure to check the price tag and do not fall for the shopkeeper’s sweet talk.

featured_reviews.name: kedar naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had one of the worst customer service experiences at this shoe shop and would strongly advise others to think twice before visiting.

I went there with my family to purchase shoes for my young daughter. As any parent would understand, choosing the right footwear for a child takes time—we were carefully checking size, comfort, and fit. However, the shopkeeper was extremely impatient and kept making rude remarks about the time we were taking, which was completely unnecessary.

What made things worse was his behavior toward our 2-year-old child. She was simply walking around the shop like any toddler would, and instead of being understanding, he became visibly irritated and started arguing about it. This created a very uncomfortable situation for us.

Despite us speaking politely and respectfully throughout (especially considering he is an elder), his tone remained rude and dismissive. The situation escalated to the point where he bluntly told us to leave the shop, which was shocking and highly unprofessional.

During the short time we were there (around 20 minutes), we also witnessed him arguing with at least two other customers. This clearly shows that this is not a one-off incident but a pattern of behavior.

Another thing we noticed was a clear inconsistency in how customers were treated. While he was impatient and rude with us, his behavior changed when women customers entered the shop—he became noticeably more attentive and willing to show multiple design options. As a customer, this felt unfair and uncomfortable to observe.

A shop is not just about products but also about how customers are treated. No one should feel rushed, disrespected, or unwelcome—especially when shopping with family.

Overall, this was a very unpleasant and stressful experience. There are many other shops that value customers and treat them with basic courtesy. I would not recommend this place.
